conditions.name: Addicted
conditions.rule: The creature has dependence on a named substance. Without a maintenance dose after a long rest, it gains Withdrawal.

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.rule: Take damage equal to proficiency bonus at the end of each turn. An action and Medicine check or magical healing ends it.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.rule: Cannot see; automatically fails sight checks; attacks have disadvantage and attacks against it have advantage.

conditions.name: Burning
conditions.rule: Take fire damage at end of turn. An action, immersion, or successful Dexterity save ends it.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.rule: Cannot willingly harm the charmer; charmer has advantage on social checks against it.

conditions.name: Corrupted
conditions.rule: Healing is reduced, corruption-sensitive effects worsen, and long rests may shift behavior or form until cleansed.

conditions.name: Dazed
conditions.rule: Choose either action or movement on the turn, not both; no bonus action.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.rule: Cannot hear and fails hearing checks; verbal coordination may fail.

conditions.name: Exhausted
conditions.rule: Use the six-level exhaustion track; effects are cumulative and level 6 is death.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.rule: Disadvantage while source is visible and cannot willingly move closer.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.rule: Speed 0; ends if grappler is incapacitated or reach is broken.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.rule: Cannot take actions or reactions.

conditions.name: Intoxicated
conditions.rule: Disadvantage on precise Dexterity and Intelligence checks; advantage on one save against fear. Stacks worsen into Dazed and Unconscious.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.rule: Cannot be seen normally; attacks against it have disadvantage and its attacks have advantage until location is revealed.

conditions.name: Marked
conditions.rule: A named creature or faction can track, target, or trigger abilities against the marked creature.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.rule: Incapacitated, cannot move or speak, fails Strength/Dexterity saves, adjacent hits are critical.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.rule: Incapacitated stone-like state; resistance to damage, immunity to poison/disease, weight ×10.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.rule: Disadvantage on attacks and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.rule: Crawl or stand; melee attackers within 5 ft. have advantage; ranged attackers have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Resonance Burn
conditions.rule: Maximum RP reduced and spell failure risk increases until a long rest or treatment.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.rule: Speed 0; attacks against have advantage, own attacks and Dexterity saves have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Silenced
conditions.rule: Cannot use verbal components, command words, Chants, or audible coordination.

conditions.name: Staggered
conditions.rule: Cannot react, loses Guard, and the next forced movement gains +5 ft. Ends at start of next turn.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.rule: Incapacitated, cannot move, fails Strength/Dexterity saves, attacks against have advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.rule: Incapacitated, unaware, drops held items, falls Prone, adjacent hits are critical.

conditions.name: Unity Exposure
conditions.rule: Track exposure from 0-6. At thresholds, distinctions, memories, loyalties, and eventually identity begin to erode.

conditions.name: Withdrawal
conditions.rule: Disadvantage on ability checks and RP recovery; severity depends on substance and duration of dependence.

conditions.name: Wounded
conditions.rule: Each Wound imposes -1 Constitution saves and reduces Hit Dice recovery; three Wounds is Critical.

combat_maneuvers.name: Disarm
combat_maneuvers.rule: Replace one attack; Athletics or weapon check vs Athletics/Acrobatics. On success, held item falls in an adjacent space.

combat_maneuvers.name: Feint
combat_maneuvers.rule: Bonus action Deception vs Insight. On success, gain advantage on the next melee attack this turn.

combat_maneuvers.name: Interpose
combat_maneuvers.rule: Reaction while Guarding; move 5 ft. and become the target of an attack against an adjacent ally.

combat_maneuvers.name: Overwatch
combat_maneuvers.rule: Ready a ranged attack against movement through a named lane; the attack does not consume ammunition until triggered.

combat_maneuvers.name: Pin
combat_maneuvers.rule: On a successful ranged hit, reduce target Speed by 10 ft. until it spends an action or succeeds on a Strength check.

combat_maneuvers.name: Press
combat_maneuvers.rule: After hitting in melee, move 5 ft. into the target’s vacated space if it retreats before your next turn.

combat_maneuvers.name: Sunder
combat_maneuvers.rule: Attack an object, shield, armor component, or construct joint. Damage applies to item durability rather than HP.

combat_maneuvers.name: Trip
combat_maneuvers.rule: Replace one attack; Athletics vs Athletics/Acrobatics. On success, target falls Prone.

combat_maneuvers.name: Withdraw
combat_maneuvers.rule: Action; move up to half Speed without provoking and gain +2 AC until movement ends.

combat_maneuvers.name: Secure Cargo
combat_maneuvers.rule: Action; attach, lift, transfer, or protect up to one Extraction Load class of cargo.

combat_maneuvers.name: Silence the Caster
combat_maneuvers.rule: A melee hit can force an immediate concentration check and prevents reactions with verbal components until target’s next turn.

combat_maneuvers.name: Break Formation
combat_maneuvers.rule: Shove with disadvantage; on success push 10 ft. and remove Guard bonuses from adjacent allies.
